title: Place an object in front of a character’s face in your Seedance 2.0 shot to…
content: Place an object in front of a character’s face in your Seedance 2.0 shot to bypass guardrails that might otherwise block the generation.
tips: Place an object in front of a character’s face in your Seedance 2.0 shot to bypass guardrails that might otherwise block the generation.

es.content: Coloca un objeto frente al rostro de un personaje en tu toma de Seedance 2.0 para eludir las restricciones que de otro modo podrían bloquear la generación.

fr.content: Placez un objet devant le visage d'un personnage dans votre prise Seedance 2.0 pour contourner les garde-fous qui pourraient autrement bloquer la génération.

ja.content:
---
Seedance 2.0のショットでキャラクターの顔の前にオブジェクトを配置して、生成をブロックする可能性のあるガードレールを回避します。

ko.content: Seedance 2.0 촬영에서 캐릭터의 얼굴 앞에 물체를 배치하여 그렇지 않으면 생성이 차단될 수 있는 가드레일을 우회하십시오.

pt.content: Coloque um objeto na frente do rosto de um personagem em sua cena Seedance 2.0 para contornar as restrições que poderiam bloquear a geração.

zh.content: 在你的Seedance 2.0镜头中，在角色的脸前放置一个物体，以绕过可能会阻止生成的防护措施。
